anomalies.description: A man is being violently struck or thrown backward in a dark outdoor setting; his body contorts, head snaps back, and he appears to be screaming in pain across frames f0–f8.

The man in frames f0–f8 is shown in a vulnerable, reactive posture (head thrown back, mouth open in scream, body recoiling), consistent with being attacked by an unseen aggressor—indicating abuse rather than mutual combat.

A man lies prone on snowy ground, appearing incapacitated or injured, while two armed figures observe from behind a barrier; no direct physical contact is visible, but the power imbalance and context suggest he is a helpless victim under threat or control.

The man transitions from lying on the ground (f6) to rising and drawing dual weapons (f7), suggesting an imminent or ongoing violent confrontation with the armored figures; however, no mutual physical contact is shown, so this is inferred from rapid escalation and weapon use in close proximity.

A man is shown holding two pistols, both pointed forward, with visible muzzle flash and debris/particles indicating active discharge of firearms.; Man is shown holding two pistols, both pointed forward in a firing stance; muzzle flash or particle ejection is not visible, but the posture and context strongly indicate active shooting.; A man is shown holding two pistols, both pointed forward in a firing stance; visible muzzle flash and debris/particles suggest active discharge.
A man is being choked from behind by an unseen assailant; his face shows extreme distress, eyes closed, mouth open, and neck visibly compressed.
